name: fifl-site
description: Static site for Food Industry Fabrication Ltd. No dependencies — npm is only a task runner for the scripts in tools/.

scripts.check: npm run check:partials && npm run check:colours
scripts.deploy: npm run check && npm run build && npx wrangler@4.115.0 pages deploy dist --project-name=fifl-site --branch=master --commit-dirty=true
